title: Expanded World
description: A mod that adds more to your Minecraft world to explore.
body:
Expanded World is now dead and depricated. Please consider checking out it's sequel; [Expanded Universe](https://modrinth.com/mod/expanded-universe)

![Expanded World Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/32431d47e61d3fd136fca8f6add2afa379886dc1.png)

Expanded World is a mod that aims to add more content to Minecraft for players to explore.

Information Section:

- This mod is currently only for Forge and I currently am unable to port it to Fabric. If I figure out a way, I'll consider porting the mod
- Updates are still being worked on for this mod however they will probably be few and far between as my computer can take upwards of 1 hour to load workspaces in MCreator (the program I'm using to make the mod).

Features List:


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

V1:

- Enderite
- Evil Allay
- 4 Paintings
- 3 Villager Professions
- End Emerald Ore
- Emerald Nuggets
- 3 Achievements

Beta V1.5:

- 19 Music Discs
- 1 Painting
- 3 Structures
- 1 Biome
- 1 Achievement

V2:

- Added some huge amount of structures (I forgot how many and it isn't worth an hour wait just to see how many I added)
- Deprecated the Evil Allay
- Put all the music discs into the correct creative inventory menu
Made all discs obtainable(?)

V3:

- Wasteland Dimension
- 2 Biomes
- Ash Wood Set
- Emerald Tool & Armor Set
- Copper Tool & Armor Set
- 3 Advancements
- Logo GUI Overlay on Menu
- The Frozen

</details>
